message:
Last week, during a surprise summer storm, the power went out just as I was settling in with my favorite book. I had recently set up a little emergency kit with flashlights, a lantern, and a fully charged power bank for my phone. As the house went dark, I couldn’t help but feel a bit smug, thinking, "I told you so!" to my family who rolled their eyes when I suggested we prep for outages. 

We lit up the room with the lantern and enjoyed some quality time together, sharing stories by its warm glow. It was a cozy reminder that a little planning goes a long way in keeping things comfortable when the unexpected happens. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during a blackout?
